verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Raygun's crash reporting core (stack traces, environment, host details) and platform-specific artifacts like JavaScript source maps, dSYM uploads (iOS) and ProGuard mapping (Android), which imply SDK support across web and mobile, and a community comment praises .NET/WinRT support suggesting backend/desktop coverage. However there is no explicit documentation enumerating official SDKs per language/platform or confirming automatic uncaught-error capture across all listed surfaces (web, backend, mobile) in one place. missing for 10: an explicit SDK list/matrix covering web, backend, and mobile with automatic uncaught-exception capture confirmed for each, and independent verification beyond a single anecdotal HN comment.
